title: Authorizer pools after a block
summary: The block at slot 57 has 1 guarantee, on core 1. That core drops the authorizer its guarantee used. Every core then appends its queue's entry for slot 57, and a pool that would exceed $\mathsf{O}$ = 8 loses its oldest entry.
params: the tiny chain the v0.8.0 vectors were made with ($\mathsf{E}$ = 12 slots per epoch, $\mathsf{Y}$ = 10, $\mathsf{C}$ = 2 cores, 6 validators), $\mathsf{O}$ = 8, $\mathsf{Q}$ = 80
notes: No accumulation runs in these vectors, so the queue $\phi'$ is the prior queue $\phi$.
name: authorization-pools
check: The model's result equals the vector's expected output, compared as `lake build authtest` compares every vector of the suite; the generator repeats that comparison for this one.
